title: Expense - Data API
description: Represents an expense linked to a work order. Service resource technicians can log expenses, such as tools or travel costs. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: The ID of the account associated with the linked work order.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only if the multicurrency feature is enabled. Contains the ISO code for any currency allowed by the organization.

Discount.description: The percentage deducted from the Subtotal price. Available in version 51.0 and later.

ExpenseEndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExpenseEndDate.description: If the expense was incurred over multiple days, the Expense End Date is the last day that the expense covers.

ExpenseNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
ExpenseNumber.description: The number that uniquely identifies the expense.

ExpenseStartDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExpenseStartDate.description: If the expense was incurred over multiple days, the Expense Start Date is the first day that the expense covers.

ExpenseType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExpenseType.description: The type of expense. Possible values are: Billable Non-Billable The default value is Billable.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns the expense record.

Quantity.description: The number of items purchased in this record. Available in version 51.0 and later.

Subtotal.description: The subtotal price calculated as the product of Quantity and UnitPrice. Available in version 51.0 and later. This is a calculated field.

Title.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Title.description: A title that identifies the expense. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later.

TotalPrice.description: The total price of the transaction which is equal to the discounted subtotal: Subtotal - (Discount * Subtotal). Available in version 51.0 and later. This is a calculated field.

TransactionDate.description: The day that the expense was incurred, or the payment date for the expense.

UnitPrice.description: The price of one item on the record. Available in version 51.0 and later.

WorkOrderId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WorkOrderId.description: The ID of the work order associated with the expense.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **ExpenseChangeEvent (API version 55.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ExpenseFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **ExpenseHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ExpenseOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **ExpenseShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
